mapper.select: SELECT p.* FROM WALLET_LIMIT_POLICY p JOIN USERS u ON u.member_grade = p.member_grade AND u.user_idx = #{userIdx} WHERE p.is_active = 1 LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM WALLET_LIMIT_POLICY ORDER BY FIELD(member_grade, 'BRONZE','SILVER','GOLD','DIAMOND','PLATINUM'), member_grade
SELECT * FROM WALLET_LIMIT_POLICY WHERE member_grade = #{memberGrade} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: INSERT INTO WALLET_LIMIT_POLICY (member_grade, single_limit, daily_limit, monthly_limit, is_active, updated_by_user_idx) VALUES (#{memberGrade}, #{singleLimit}, #{dailyLimit}, #{monthlyLimit}, #{isActive}1, #{updatedByUserIdx}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE single_limit = VALUES(single_limit), daily_limit = VALUES(daily_limit), monthly_limit = VALUES(monthly_limit), is_active = VALUES(is_active), updated_by_user_idx = VALUES(updated_by_user_idx)
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(final_amount), 0) FROM USER_PAYMENT_HISTORY WHERE user_idx = #{userIdx} AND payment_type = 'CHARGE' AND payment_status = 'COMPLETED' AND DATE(paid_at) = CURDATE()

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(final_amount), 0) FROM USER_PAYMENT_HISTORY WHERE user_idx = #{userIdx} AND payment_type = 'CHARGE' AND payment_status = 'COMPLETED' AND paid_at >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-01') AND paid_at < DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-01') + INTERVAL 1 MONTH
